name: neon-night-masquerade-fashion
image_purpose: Night fashion and event social content

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic raw-flash editorial portrait on a luxury rooftop or balcony at night.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman in her early 20s with long thick dark-brown hair, expressive eyes, natural confident expression and realistic skin texture. She wears a silver sequin dress with secure full coverage and a high elegant neckline, a minimal diamond necklace, and holds an ornate silver-and-black Venetian masquerade mask in her raised right hand. Her left hand rests at her hip in a poised fashion stance.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 close portrait with the subject near the camera, slight forward lean, chin gently lowered and eyes toward the lens. Keep the ornate mask fully visible near her cheek and a very dark softly blurred city-light background with no readable signs.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct flash slightly above eye level, crisp highlights on eyes, cheekbones, collarbones, sequins and mask, clean shadows, raw paparazzi-flash aesthetic and nocturnal rooftop mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical 3:4 raw fashion photography, full-frame camera with 35mm lens, tack-sharp eyes and mask, shallow depth of field, natural pores and hair strands, controlled sequin reflections, subtle grain, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic vertical 3:4 raw-flash editorial portrait of one generic approved adult woman in her early 20s with long thick dark-brown hair, expressive eyes, natural confident expression and realistic skin texture, standing close to the camera on a luxury rooftop or balcony at night. She wears a silver sequin dress with secure full coverage and a high elegant neckline, a minimal diamond necklace, and holds an ornate silver-and-black Venetian masquerade mask raised near her cheek and fully visible. Her left hand rests at her hip in a poised fashion stance, with a slight forward lean and chin gently lowered. Direct flash slightly above eye level creates crisp highlights on the eyes, mask and sequins, with a very dark softly blurred city-light background and no readable signs, natural pores, hair strands and subtle film grain, no logos, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, deep neckline, cleavage emphasis, body-part close-up, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate subject, unreadable text, logos, watermark
